steps.content: [Nirvana Cybersecurity Center]

steps.speaker: Announcement
steps.content: There was a digitalized Mania leak near Banyan Medical College in Eastside. The MBCC Chief was injured and his mental condition is unstable. According to his testimony, a girl was also attacked at the scene and is currently missing.
steps.female_content: There was a digitalized Mania leak near Banyan Medical College in Eastside. The MBCC Chief was injured and her mental condition is unstable. According to her testimony, a girl was also attacked at the scene and is currently missing.

steps.speaker: Announcement
steps.content: Before Chief returns to the front line, the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center will continue to track and analyze, assisting the Bureau and FAC in advancing the investigation.
The Nirvana Cybersecurity Center becomes busy again. Technicians stay up late tracking every clue on the dark web.

<color=#fb9259>ID 004</color>: Please provide the data analysis on Mania activity in the area before and after the attack.
<color=#fb9259>ID 046</color>: There was no significant movement on the dark web within the monitored range before or after the attack, and no group has claimed responsibility. The attacker's special abilities rivaled Chief's shackles, demonstrating considerable strength, yet they consciously limited the damage to a 20-meter radius.
<color=#fb9259>ID 046</color>: Furthermore, the precision of the limitation ensured no collateral damage.

<color=#fb9259>ID 004</color>: Can we identify the suspect?
<color=#fb9259>ID 079</color>: It would be hard for an organization with that level of power to remain hidden, except for the Underground. However, the 9th Agency believes such a restrained attack doesn't align with the Underground's usual methods.
<color=#fb9259>ID 004</color>: There are still vast phantom spaces on the dark web beyond our surveillance. Look into that.
<color=#fb9259>ID 080</color>: Understood. But we're severely understaffed, and our key members haven't fully recovered from the Elysiland operation.

<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: All monitoring terminals in the area were heavily disrupted, leaving no on-site footage. Potential witnesses are showing symptoms of dark web syndrome, including memory loss.
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: There's another victim. Based on Chief's description, we’ve created a portrait, but we still can’t confirm her identity.

<color=#fb9259>ID 004</color>: How's Chief?
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: ...
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: He has woken up. There are no obvious physical anomalies. We are awaiting detailed medical reports.
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: But his emotions are very unstable. Even if we ask him to put aside work to recuperate, he will definitely...
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>ID 004</color>: How's Chief?
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: ...
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: She has woken up. There are no obvious physical anomalies. We are awaiting detailed medical reports.
<color=#fb9259>ID 066</color>: But her emotions are very unstable. Even if we ask her to put aside work to recuperate, she will definitely...

steps.content: (Cancel darkened background, display Rise's picture)
Rise silently watches the work group chat as messages constantly pop up on the screen.

Having finished all the work she had on hand, she had applied for a week-long leave starting tomorrow. But after seeing how busy her colleagues were, she reconsiders, cancels the leave application, and makes a call.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Mom, I won't be coming back tomorrow. Emergency overtime.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Hmm... Yeah, don't worry, it's not dangerous. I applied for it myself... No, no one picked on me. They wouldn't dare. Plus, they'll pay me quadruple. I'll buy gifts for you and dad.
She hangs up, throws on her coat, and rushes out. They need someone experienced with liaising to handle the upcoming operation.
[Scene Change] Chief's Office
You sit in the office with the dark web portal open, repeatedly entering similar strings in the address bar. Your eyes are dry and sore, but you have no time to worry about that now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That address... the one she left on the popsicle stick...
You open the URL and arrive at a blank white page.
You open the URL and get a long string of gibberish. Classic DisMyth spam.
A form of color blindness in which only yellow and blue can be perceived... according to the dictionary. But there's no corresponding site.
These are all you remember from the flashing characters...
After being brought back, the wooden stick underwent multiple inspections. No one found anything abnormal. It has no writing or markings, making your persistence seem almost laughable.

But this attack is not your imagination. You won't give up easily or dismiss it as a hallucination. You are determined to get to the bottom of it and find the strange girl who was torn apart in front of you.
[Amnesia CG] followed by intense white flash

Ridiculous. Now you can't even remember how she looked. Just like the information she hid in the popsicle stick, your memories about her are rapidly fading, even though you're not someone who forgets easily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's not a hallucination. I must remember. The clues can't be lost.
You choose from many possible types of passwords, finally pinpointing three words that seem most suspicious...
The well-known slogan on the dark web is welcometodismyth, which appears in various places... Could it correspond to a website? No, you need to remove "dis"...
[Click, website opens]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Found it!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What is this?!
A plaintext website?!
This is definitely not a plaintext website. It's as if something has been determined. After a strange screen flash, chaotic characters quickly fill the screen, and you enter another area.

Lonely Island was attacked. All the priests are dead. Only managed to take away ■■■. The remaining ■■ couldn't all be destroyed. They were all taken ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■
■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ N.F. 112, MBCC's authority transferred. ■■■■ returned to the EDGE, management authority temporarily handed over to ■■. ■■■■■■ except S-019, all deep experimental subjects and data have been transferred. ■■■■■■■■■■■■■
Joint agreement signatories ■■■■■■ 8 voted against ■■■■■■■■■■■■■ City-state enters wartime state ■■■■■■■■

<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: You're the one who told ${PlayerName} my location, right?</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: Come out, I know you've been watching. ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: I'd say I hid well these days. The only person who could find me is probably...</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: You, the one who's capable of hacking the dark web and tampering with the order. ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: He's already safe. I took the job, and I'll watch over him. You didn't have to do that.</color>
steps.female_content:
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: You're the one who told ${PlayerName} my location, right?</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: Come out, I know you've been watching. ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: I'd say I hid well these days. The only person who could find me is probably...</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: You, the one who's capable of hacking the dark web and tampering with the order. ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■</color>
<color=#3CB371>angell_1231: She's already safe. I took the job, and I'll watch over her. You didn't have to do that.</color>

steps.content: Chaotic information keeps rolling out rapidly. These words flashing among the incomprehensible symbols leave you stunned.
You quickly realize that, regardless of its authenticity, this is crucial information that must be preserved.
[Glitch]
---Error--- ---Error--- ---Error---
Your computer suddenly goes out of control, with countless garbled symbols devouring the information on the screen.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's a cyber attack!
It's too late. Within seconds, all the characters dissolve into gibberish before your eyes, and there is nothing you can do about it.
As you watch, all the facts come together in your mind.

...The initial apparition that only you could see, the girl killed by the apparition right after contacting you, the intelligence she secretly hid deep within the dark web, and the rapidly destroyed "last words."
You leave a message for Nightingale as quickly as possible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Immediately contact the Cybersecurity Center to investigate the address 'welcometomyth' and its owner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The murdered girl must be identified. Who is she? What did she want to tell me? Who killed her and why? I need to know all the truth.
After leaving the message, you throw on your coat and rush to the door, swinging it open, only to bump into an unexpected person.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Hi.
The sudden appearance of someone at the door startles you. When you see her face, you immediately recall every detail, including how she had been pierced and torn apart. Your heart almost stops.
You grab her tightly as soon as you remember everything.
At this moment, your actions and tone are far from gentle, but the person in front of you does not flinch.
As if she doesn't understand, she grabs your sleeve in return, trying to slink behind you.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Help me.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: They're coming.
...They?
The space behind her suddenly flickers, and dozens of chaotic rifts tear open the space, emitting a familiar, ear-piercing roar.
The girl shrinks closer to you. For a moment, the image of her being pierced by the apparition flashes again, and you instinctively grab her arm, disregarding your suspicions.
You pull her back into the room, hoping to rely on the office's defense system can hold off the monsters for a while. But as you step inside, the ground beneath you feels anything but solid.
...Looking up, you see the floor, walls, and ceiling of the room already covered in illusory patterns, with filthy signals leaking out ceaselessly. You are stepping right on a trace of light.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Oh no...
Before you can finish your words, you fall instantly, along with the girl tightly held in your arms, into a digital noise-filled abyss.

steps.speaker: Technician A
steps.content: An emergency has occurred at the MBCC! There is a massive contamination leakage near Chief's office. The data type is consistent with the daytime Eastside attack, and it is extremely invasive!

steps.speaker: Technician B
steps.content: MBCC, take the lead for now. Send your Sinners to rescue your Chief. Cybersecurity will arrive soon.

steps.speaker: Technician A
steps.content: But that Chief... That Chief is gone! He has vanished into thin air!!
steps.female_content: But that Chief... That Chief is gone! She has vanished into thin air!!

steps.content: The Cybersecurity Center falls into chaos. While people rush about, a small break room on the edge of the office area lights up.

steps.speaker: Soft Female Voice
steps.content: Vanished into thin air...?
The woman props herself up from the bed and puts on her glasses. Her mechanical assistant floats over to light up the computer screen. Data flashes rapidly across her lenses.
After reading for a long time, a smile curls on her face.

steps.speaker: Soft Female Voice
steps.content: Oh dear, it's only been a little while and there's trouble again... Wonderful.

steps.speaker: Soft Female Voice
steps.content: This is a never-before-seen abnormal state.
